evidence.quote: The probability of a payout is calibrated. In 1,660 storm county-months the Brier score was 0.177 against 0.224 for the historical frequency

practical_problems.note: Loss and payout probability are checked against insured-loss records in held-out years and against independent production records, i.e. consequences in crop value rather than weather accuracy. calibration: decision metrics against baselines only, no mechanism ablation or cost variation.

evidence.quote: The platform runs the tools and records each result as a receipt that holds the value, its unit, the data version and the filters applied.

practical_problems.note: Source receipts make each number traceable, but no experiment measures faithfulness or user review of receipts.

summary: A tool-grounded agent turns dated weather evidence into hazard tiers and calibrated crop-loss estimates with source receipts; evaluation checks hazard indices and loss against insurance and independent records rather than against agent baselines.
